content.title: Blackstone Nears $4 Billion Deal for MacLean Power Systems
content.summary: The private equity firm may announce a purchase of MacLean from Centerbridge Partners as soon as next week, the people said, asking not to be identified discussing confidential information.  Blackstone beat out other suitors including ABB Ltd., with the Swiss industrial giant deciding against increasing its offer for MacLean, some of the people said.  Representatives for Blackstone, Centerbridge and ABB declined to comment.
